# Name: # Flash layout for the VVM701 gateway — IDENTICAL to alds-sr-vvm701-fw and
# cng-cpil-vvm701-fw DELIBERATELY. The same physical VVM701 board moves
# between fleets and is reflashed with a different product's firmware in the
# field. When all products share ONE flash map
Type: a swap only has to rewrite

# Name: # the app slot (and otadata) — nvs and the littlefs storage partition sit at
# the same offset and size whichever firmware is loaded
# reflash can never land an image whose idea of where NVS or the queue lives
# disagrees with the table already on the chip. Diverging tables would make
# every swap a full erase-and-reflash and turn any app-only flash into a brick.
# THIS TABLE IS NOT OTA-UPDATABLE. Changing it means reflashing every unit
# over serial. It is effectively permanent once the first unit ships.
# CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET in sdkconfig.defaults MUST match 0xC000:
# a mismatch is not a build error — it is a device that does not boot.
# Bootloader has 0xC000 (48 KB) of space. The non-secure-boot bootloader is
# ~20 KB so this is ample headroom.
# App slots are 64 KB aligned. Both keep their full 7 MB.
# nvs keeps 0x5000 (20 KB) — NVS needs at least 3 sectors to garbage-collect.
nvs
otadata
app0
app1
storage
